home.title: Made for you, by the next generation of designers.
home.lead: Commission a custom piece — a dress for one evening, trousers cut for longer legs — from fashion students building their portfolios. Real craft, fairer prices, and your payment is held until your piece arrives.
home.howTitle: From an idea to a piece that fits — in three steps.
home.howLead: Describe it once. Students who can make it send you a fixed quote. You choose by portfolio, reviews, price and timeline.
home.step1: Pick a garment, add your measurements with the guided fit form and reference photos, and say how it should reach you.
home.step2: Verified fashion students reply with a fixed quote. Ask questions in messages, look at their portfolios, then choose.
home.step3: You pay when you accept, but the money is only released once you confirm the piece arrived — and it joins the student’s portfolio.
home.pricingTitle: Student rates. Real craft. No surprises.
home.pricingLead: Students set their own prices — usually below a standard tailor, because every commission also builds their portfolio.
home.pricing1: Pay when you accept — held until you’ve received it
home.pricing2: Meet locally or have it shipped; alterations offered per quote
home.pricing3: Something wrong? Report it and our team steps in
home.ratesEmpty: Rates appear once makers publish their rate guides.
home.ratesNote: Starting points before fabric, from student rate guides. Your quote is fixed when you accept it.
home.studentsTitle: Build your portfolio on real briefs — and get paid for it.
home.studentsLead: Take on commissions that fit your skills and your timetable. Every finished piece can go straight into a portfolio clients, tutors and employers can see.
home.feature1: Quote per piece. Accept only what you can make well.
home.feature2: Completed commissions become portfolio pieces in one click.
home.feature3: The customer pays before you cut any fabric.
home.feature4: Pause requests during exams or show season.
home.finalTitle: Have something in mind that the shops never get right?
home.finalLead: Describe it in a few minutes. Student makers who can make it reply with quotes.

wizard.title: Request a custom piece
wizard.freeToPost: Free to post. You only pay once you accept a quote — and it’s held until your piece arrives.
wizard.measurementsLead: This is where made-to-measure wins. Measure over light clothing, barefoot, in centimetres. Your maker double-checks everything.
wizard.figureCaption: Green: inseam, crotch to floor. Clay: natural waist.
wizard.measureInPerson: Not sure? Have your maker take your measurements in person or on a video call.
wizard.descriptionPlaceholder: Silhouette, fabric weight, colour, details like pockets or lining, and anything shops always get wrong for you.
wizard.fabricOwnHint: Hand it over or post it to your maker
wizard.fabricSourceHint: Shown as a separate line in the quote
wizard.neededByHint: Allow at least 3 weeks for most pieces.
wizard.cityHint: Only your city is shown, so makers can tell whether they can meet you.
wizard.photosHint: Inspiration pictures, the piece you want reworked, or your fabric. Up to 6.
wizard.photosAfterSignup: You can add photos once you’ve created your account — your draft is saved, just come back to this step.
wizard.sendToAll: Send to all matching makers instead
wizard.paymentNote: Nothing is charged now. When you accept a quote you pay it in full; we hold it until you confirm you’ve received your piece. Only then is it released to the student.
wizard.accountNote: You’ll create a free account (or sign in) to send this — your request is saved.

setup.title: Payouts & verification
setup.verifyLead: Customers trust students, so every maker is verified. Use your school email for instant verification, or upload a student card.
setup.pending: We’re checking your document — usually within 1 working day.
setup.rejected: Your last verification wasn’t approved. You can try again.

setup.taxLead: EU law (DAC7) requires platforms to report what sellers earn to the tax authority once a year. We encrypt your tax number and only use it for that report.
setup.payoutsLead: We use Stripe to verify your identity and pay you out to your bank account. It takes about five minutes.
setup.payoutsPending: Stripe is still checking your details. This page updates when they’re done.
setup.allSet: You’re all set — you can send quotes now.
